name: pilot tools
summary: The pilot has no bash; it reads, writes, edits, greps and globs. Some commands may be granted back later.
statement: The Pilot does not use bash tools. Some may be granted back later. The pilot reads, writes, edits, greps and globs.
brief: Written by the commander under a Commander Response heading inside the pilot's draft decision XD-001 (records/pilot/decisions/XD-001.md), which answers CQ-001 on the order and crew for the corpus migration. The pilot had been running python and shell commands to file records and lint; this order ends that. The constitution's pilot constraints say bash is restricted with pre-approved commands excepted and grep restricted; this order is tighter than that on bash until commands are granted back. Amended by the commander on 2026-09-25 to grant grep. Universal conduct: a candidate for promotion to a standing order.
